description: Delete a resource by UUID. JSON:API: DELETE /jsonapi/{entity_type}/{bundle}/{uuid} → 204 (empty body). Returns a small confirmation.

entity_type.description: The entity type machine name, e.g. "node", "taxonomy_term", "user".

uuid.description: The entity UUID (JSON:API uses the UUID, never the numeric id).

name: drupal_delete_resource
title: Delete resource
